title: Chroma Resampler
text: Downsample or upsample chrominance component, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Antialiasing filter} sets Lowpass filter to follow downsample operation; {Resampling} sets the type of resampling 4:4:4, {Horizontal filter coefficients} sets the coefficients for the antialiasing filter, {Interpolation}, {Rounding mode} sets the rounding method for internal fixed-point calculations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow action for internal fixed-point and {Filter coefficients} sets the data type for antialiasing filter coefficients. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: pixel
ports.summary: Input pixel stream in Y’CbCr color space vector | matrix

params.name: Antialiasing filter
params.values: Lowpass filter to follow downsample operation Auto (default) | Property | None

params.name: Horizontal filter coefficients
params.values: Coefficients for the antialiasing filter [0.2 0.6 0.2] (default) | vector

params.name: Interpolation
params.values: Interpolation method for an upsample operation Linear (default) | Pixel replication

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding method for internal fixed-point calculations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Overflow action for internal fixed-point calculations off (default) | on

params.name: Filter coefficients
params.values: Data type for antialiasing filter coefficients fixdt(1,16,15) (default) | data type expression
